mentions.h: JUNIOR MATCH v. HERNE HILL HARRIERS

mentions.note: won in record time, 5 hrs. 52 m. 22 s. for 52¼ miles

mentions.h: BELS FAIL BY 14secs / TITLE LOST IN "SOUTHERN" RELAY

photos.c: Just back from injury, JIM VIVIAN splits Knowles (Brighton & H.) and Reynolds (TVH) in the Brockman 100. But he was unable to recover his old dash in time for the A.A.A. Championships where he was eliminated in 11.2.
